newsitem.title: GREECE: Development Fund says ytd net tops 1996.
newsitem.headline: Development Fund says ytd net tops 1996.

text.p: Closed-end Development Fund said its realised profit in the year-to-May 21 period reached 363 million drachmas, an amount which far exceeded its fiscal 1996 results.
On the same date, its portfolio had unrealised capital gains
in excess of 800 million drachmas and was allocated as follows:
Bearer and registered shares of Development Fund traded at a 10.8 and 13.2 percent discount to their net asset value (NAV) of 1,233 drachmas on May 21, it said.
A dividend per share of 70 drachmas was declared for fiscal 1996, flat on the previous year, which will be distributed on June 17.
Shares of Development Fund trade ex-div on Monday May 26.

Development Fund posted 1996 earnings of 279 million drachmas, up 10 percent on the previous year. Total capital gains and portfolio income was up 8.9 percent to 362 million drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
